verdict.rationale: AWS's own documentation says the CLI provides functionality equivalent to the browser-based Management Console (aws-docs-42), with one tool controlling multiple services and scriptable automation (aws-docs-1). This is backed by programmatic provisioning through CloudFormation and CDK (aws-docs-6, aws-docs-26), API access to cost data (aws-docs-16), and official MCP servers and an official CLI (aws-probe-4, aws-probe-5). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that every console action has an API equivalent, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (aws-probe-3 returned 404).
